latest_release.name: v3.3.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

Another release! This one isn't quite a big or heavy on the bugfixes as some of our other releases, but I wanted to get something out to you all anyway.

Most significantly, @ecairol did some amazing work enhancing how Harper ranks its spelling suggestions. You'll find that the suggestions in this version are for more correct _in context_ than ever before. Definitely a welcome improvement.
We also added the ability to load Weirpacks in the Desktop app, after several requests. In the Chrome Extension, you should see more relevant checks in more places.

Hopefully we can get another release out soon with some more improvements we've been cooking up. Until then, cheers! 

## The PRs We Merged
* fix(core): mark "learnt", "burnt" and "leapt" as past forms by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4874
* test(chrome-ext): stop stray blurs failing the iframe popup tests by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4947
* fix(TheyToThem): avoid flagging coordinating conjunction 'for they' by @abdul-karim-mia in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4926
* feat: them selves → themselves by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4897
* feat: despite he is → although/even though he is by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4887
* fix(core): don't ask for a preposition after "have" as a main verb by @ozenyunus35 in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4622
* fix(core): don't flag the acronym "RE" in "the RE process" by @ozenyunus35 in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4632
* feat: update dictionary regular past verbs `/j` vs `/tT` by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4965
* docs: update stale paths in AGENTS.md by @shoustak in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4951
* fix(core): detect "to" before degree words followed by nouns mid-sentence by @draphy in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/3131
* feat(desktop): allow restarting onboarding from settings by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4934
* test(chrome-ext): fix the most common flaky extension tests by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4943
* ci: stop release builds crowding out PR check caches by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4952
* feat(core): add NUMBER token to Weir exprs by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4975
* feat: replace SlideDeck with something better by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4977
* feat(desktop): ability to load Weirpacks by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4923
* fix(core): mark "opening", "hearing", "prayer" and similar nouns as countable by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4855
* fix(core): don't join a closed compound that starts a hyphenated word by @costajohnt in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4786
* feat: quoted of saying→quoted as saying by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4967
* feat: on the same vein → in the same vein by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4979
* feat(core): flag 'when ever' to be joined into 'whenever' by @abdul-karim-mia in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4976
* feat:  linebreaks as whitespace in Weir `expr main` by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4699
* fix(components): darken background letters beneath text in dark mode by @elijah-potter in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4988
* style: split long/complex Weir alternatives over multiple lines by @hippietrail in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4987
* fix(git-commit): skip conventional commit prefixes when linting by @KemalG-u in https://github.com/Automattic/harper/pull/4991
* feat(core): correct licence/license and practice/practise outside American English by @GaryJones in https://github.com/Automattic/har

Harper

[![Harper Binaries](https://github.com/automattic/harper/actions/workflows/binaries.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/automattic/harper/actions/workflows/binaries.yml) [![Website](https://github.com/automattic/harper/actions/workflows/build_web.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/automattic/harper/actions/workflows/build_web.yml) [![Checks](https://github.com/automattic/harper/actions/workflows/just_checks.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/automattic/harper/actions/workflows/just_checks.yml) [![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/harper-ls)](https://crates.io/crates/harper-ls) ![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/harper.js) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/automattic/harper/total?label=Binary+Downloads) ![Obsidian Plugin Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/automattic/harper-obsidian-plugin/total?label=Obsidian+Plugin+Downloads) Harper is an English grammar checker designed to be _just right._ I created it after years of dealing with the shortcomings of the competition. Grammarly was too expensive and too overbearing. Its suggestions lacked context, and were often just plain _wrong_. Not to mention: it's a privacy nightmare. Everything you write with Grammarly is sent to their servers. Their privacy policy claims they don't sell the data, but that doesn't mean they don't use it to train large language models and god knows what else. Not only that, but the round-trip-time of the network request makes revising your work all the more tedious. LanguageTool is great, if you have gigabytes of RAM to spare and are willing to download the ~16GB n-gram dataset. Besides the memory requirements, I found LanguageTool too slow: it would take several seconds to lint even a moderate-size document. That's why I created Harper: it is the grammar checker that fits my needs. Not only does it take milliseconds to lint a document, take less than 1/50th of LanguageTool's memory footprint, but it is also completely private. Harper is even small enough to load via [WebAssembly.](https://writewithharper.com) ## Language Support Harper currently only supports English, but the core is extensible to support other languages, so we welcome contributions that allow for other language support. ## Performance Issues We consider long lint times bugs. If you encounter any significant performance issues, please create an issue on the topic. If you find a fix to any performance issue, we would appreciate the contribution. Just please make sure to read [our contribution guidelines first.](https://writewithharper.com/docs/contributors/introduction) ## Links - [Frequently Asked Questions](https://writewithharper.com/#faqs) - [Obsidian Documentation](https://writewithharper.com/docs/integrations/obsidian) - [`harper-ls` Documentation](https://writewithharper.com/docs/integrations/language-server) - Supported Editors' Documentation - [Visual Studio Code](https://writewithharper.com/docs/integrations/visual-studio-code) - [Neovim](https://writewithharper.com/docs/integrations/neovim) - [Helix](https://writewithharper.com/docs/integrations/helix) - [Emacs](https://writewithharper.com/docs/integrations/emacs) - [Zed](https://writewithharper.com/docs/integrations/zed) - [`harper.js` Documentation](https://writewithharper.com/docs/harperjs/introduction) - [Official Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/JBqcAaKrzQ) ## Huge Thanks This project would not be possible without the hard work from those who [contribute](https://writewithharper.com/docs/contributors/introduction). Harper's logo was designed by [Lukas Werner](https://lukaswerner.com/).
